mentions.name: exorsim
mentions.description: An MC6800 simulator (exorsim) with newly added EXORdisk-I support so it can boot EDOS and EDOS-II disks. EDOS was a direct 6800 port of FDOS, the first DOS for microcomputers, which ran on iCOM FD360 8-inch floppy drives.
mentions.source_excerpt: Adding EXORdisk-I support to my MC6800 simulator so that it can boot EDOS and EDOS-II disks.
